environment.themeFontWeight.title: Theme Font Weight
environment.themeFontWeight.description: Shift editor and classification weights together for light and dark themes, retaining bold and italic distinctions.

environment.themeFontWeight.lightTheme.title: Light theme font weight
environment.themeFontWeight.lightTheme.description: Relative weight shift for light themes. Light shifts regular 400 to 300 and bold 700 to 600. Other formatting is retained.

environment.themeFontWeight.darkTheme.title: Dark theme font weight
environment.themeFontWeight.darkTheme.description: Relative weight shift for dark themes. Light shifts regular 400 to 300 and bold 700 to 600. Other formatting is retained.
